d:
Celebrate the sacred month of Shravan with The Song of Shiva, a spiritually uplifting presentation by the legendary Ustad Rashid Khan.
Featuring the timeless beauty of Raga Bhairav and Raga Deshkar, this soulful performance offers a deeply devotional experience inspired by Lord Shiva. The majestic voice of Ustad Rashid Khan brings these revered ragas to life, creating an atmosphere of peace, reverence, and inner stillness.
Credits:
Artist: Ustad Rashid Khan
